_about: M3-ENV-08 post-import rules for the Brightwater ferry kit (game/core/import/brightwater_ferry_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). The same LOD table as the Haluna kit and HalunaDresser's defaults (which still override them at runtime with the layout's values); every glTF slot maps to the kit's own materials folder. The kit exports no -col proxies yet; walk collision is m2-slice's (swap-in note in docs/kb/tasks/M3/M3-ENV-08-brightwater-ferry.md).
